name: Kobold Camp Cleanup
summary: At Northshire, Kobold Camp Cleanup puts new recruits to their first test defending Stormwind's borders. Marshal McBride sends volunteers after kobolds in the northern woods, where their growing numbers threaten the abbey grounds.

sections.title: A Valley Under Pressure
sections.body: Northshire Valley once offered quiet for prayer, farming, and novice training. In recent years, Stormwind's forces have grown thin. With the King missing and royal garrisons scattered, wild creatures and opportunists press at civilization's edge. Marshal McBride directs the valley's defense from Northshire Abbey. He depends on fresh volunteers to keep threats from disrupting the abbey or endangering the surrounding vineyards.

sections.title: The Vermin in the Woods
sections.body: Kobolds are timid cave-dwellers with a strong attachment to candles. They usually pick at underground seams, far from direct sunlight. Now an entire clan has reached Northshire's northern timberline. If left unchecked, their numbers can turn scavenging into open raids. McBride sends recruits to thin their vanguard and test their resolve to defend the realm.

faq.q: Who orders the culling of the kobold camp?
faq.answer: Marshal McBride gives the order. From Northshire Abbey, he oversees recruit intake and the valley's security for Stormwind.

faq.q: Why are kobolds in the northern woods instead of a mine?
faq.answer: Kobolds usually live in burrows and mines, but Northshire's growing population has spilled into the open forest. They have made primitive camps among the northern trees, near the edge of civilized land.

faq.q: Why are these kobolds considered a threat to Stormwind?
faq.answer: Alone, kobold vermin are timid and weak. In packs, they can ambush travelers, raid supplies, and overwhelm unguarded outposts, a threat Stormwind can ill afford while its forces are stretched thin.

faq.q: Where does this mission lead next?
faq.answer: After thinning the kobolds on the surface, recruits are sent to investigate deeper into Echo Ridge Mine, where the heart of the infestation lies.

faq.q: Is Northshire receiving regular royal army backup?
faq.answer: No. Political tension and troop shortages after King Varian's disappearance leave commanders like McBride relying on civilian volunteers, adventurers, and trainees for border security.

faq.q: What makes kobolds so attached to their candles?
faq.answer: Kobolds revere candles as their main defense against the smothering darkness of underground tunnels. Their flames give them safety, sight, and a sense of ownership.

angles.text: As a human of Northshire, driving back kobold vermin is a civic duty that helps protect the abbey and farmland from being overrun.
As an Alliance member, you can see the strain on Stormwind's home territories, where even scavenger infestations call for urgent help from volunteer militia.
